header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: Same was the positron on last date of hearing when in the interest of justice instant matter was adjourned and notice of intimation was also issued to learned counsel for the petitioner; but inspite of that none has appeared today for the petitioner; which reflects that petitioner and his counsel have lost interest to pursue instant petition, therefore, same alongwith listed pending application stands dismissed for nonprosecution.
